author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Dome shower head on its pipe at the upper left spraying two streams, and a bust at the right with round shoulders and one arm raised, as in the reference. The current drawing had only a hook and a dash for the shower and a stick torso fused with a curved arm, so neither the shower head nor the person read.
omissions: The arm bends at the elbow instead of the reference's single diagonal (a straight diagonal arm would pass within 5 of the head); the spray is two streams instead of the reference's two angled dashes plus a pipe elbow.
